description:
Hello, 

 Hope you are doing great! 

 Please review the job description below and let me know if you would 
 be interested in applying for this position. I look forward to 
 receiving a Word or PDF copy of updated resume and I look forward to 
 speaking with you soon. If this job not for you, please feel free to 
 share my contact info with any of your friends or colleagues looking 
 for the same kind of role. 


 Role : Software Developer in Pittsburgh, PA or Strongsville, OH or Columbus, OH 
 Duration : 6 MONTH CONTRACT to PERM 


 Minimum 5 years development experience in: 

 Java 1.7 
 AEM 6.x 
 Oracle SQL 

 Preference 
 ETL (Informatica) 
 Spring/Struts 
 Websphere Application Server 
 JSP and Servlets 
 Lead experience (if any) 

 Must have lead skills 
 · Experience working in an Agile development environment 
 · Self-motivated 
 . Experience interfacing with Vendors and External upstream and 
 downstream systems 
 · Experience working with Product Owners extrapolating requirements 
 into technical design and development 
 · Very good communications skills 

 Product Responsibilities: 
 . The lead will be working on the Unauthenticated space of .com 
 . Deposits Online Account Opening 




 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
